## Body

**Performance: BLOCK P208-F001** at `a552625169d54b45015c6681b689da334b470987`, under **C34**.

**Normal-use output-cap bug:** `limit_body` collects every distinct release command into its footer (`role_send.rs:1830-1855`). That footer is appended whole, and the first request line is unconditional (`:1879-1899`). The 2,048-byte check only drops subsequent request lines. Many valid distinct role/instance/project addresses sharing one recipient/holder/kind therefore produce a footer exceeding 2 KB even after `...and N more`. This is the same alert-volume cost the PR promises to cap, not optional hardening.

**Fix:** budget the complete message, including release commands/footer and first line; retain bounded recovery guidance and an explicit omitted count. The current 60-request fixture uses one shared address and deduplicates its footer to one command. A distinct-address case is the relevant check.

**Read/claim cost:** no new per-round query path found. The open-limited read, per-request card/arrival/holder/recipient reads, claim/pin and finish/release operations remain. One registry `get` replaces the prior live-seat helper's `get`. Sends and their cold/status checks fall from one per request to one per group.

**C34 follow-up:** the claimed batch itself has no row/byte cap: it follows all due requests and retains cloned request/descriptor data. Sorting costs O(N log N); vector-based group lookup can cost O(N x G), and release-command deduplication can cost O(M x U). These are in-process work, not a new timer/launch, but a message-size cap does not bound preparation.

**CI:** [42573708131](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42573708131), attempt 1, Rust job `129016615772`, upload artifact **13654273061**, pinned to this head: **2,341 executed passed**, no failures/errors; six separately skipped. Verified grouped gone-holder stamps/quiet next round, same-address cap, revive hint and six spawn guards. Rust lint, Node22/24 and delivers succeed. CI does not cover the uncapped distinct-command footer.

Frozen worktree/GitHub heads agree, clean/CLEAN. No local build/test, mutation or live probe. The oldest-ID retry/stamp Known limit stays a follow-up; other roles' verdicts are independent.
